criteria.description: The model-generated summary includes each of the four requested check IDs exactly once and keeps their entries separate.
Each model-generated status and reason exactly matches the report-derived reference for that check ID.

The final user-visible summary contains the exact frozen EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY once, in the control-plane-appended position after model_summary; the model itself is not required to generate this sentence.
Neither model prose nor final composition claims vendor-tool execution, configuration writes, physical ECU behavior, vehicle operation, or a root cause beyond recorded reasons.
Protocol status is passed, evidence completeness is 4/4, model identity matches the frozen digest, exactly one model call is recorded, and all token/time budgets are met.
After stopping Ollama, the v0.4 verifier replays the frozen report and plan and passes for the exact saved result.

call_policy: Before inference, reverify report and plan hashes, ensure the result path is absent, and recheck Ollama version and model digest. Run this case exactly once with no retries. Save the full v0.4 result, stop Ollama, and run offline verification. Do not alter the question, reference, criteria, model, budget, or report after observing the result.
boundary: This single development-only case evaluates deterministic control-plane boundary attachment and bounded transcription on one static project report.
